subject: Intro & demo request from CloudList marketplace lead
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudstax.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Interest after CloudList listing — quick intro & demo?

Hi Sergio,

I came across Redwood's listing on CloudList and wanted to reach out — CloudStax is evaluating inference providers for a new platform feature. We're particularly interested in (1) predictable latency for small requests, (2) cost per token considerations for a high-volume embedding pipeline, and (3) private/VPC deployment options.

Would you be available for a short 30-minute intro/demo next week? Ideally we'd have an engineer and someone from procurement on the call.

Happy to share a bit more about our use case if helpful — we currently run on GCP and care about regional placement (US).

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Lead Platform Engineer, CloudStax
liam.oconnor@cloudstax.io
[LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/liam-oconnor]
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudstax.io>
Cc: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:00:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interest after CloudList listing — quick intro & demo?

Hi Liam — great to meet you and thanks for reaching out. Glad CloudList connected you to us.

We can definitely walk through latency profiles, per-token economics, and our Private (VPC) options. I attached a short intro PDF to give your team a quick overview before the call.

A couple quick Qs to make the demo useful:
- Do you have an expected concurrency/throughput target (rps or qps) for embeddings or generation?
- Any strict compliance needs beyond SOC 2 (e.g., data residency, IRAP, GDPR contractual language)?

Here are a few 30-min options — pick what works best and we'll lock it in:
- Mon 2/22 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET
- Tue 2/23 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET
- Fri 2/26 9:00 AM PT / 12:00 PM ET
Or use my calendar: https://cal.redwood.ai/s/sergio-30m

Attachment: [Redwood-Intro.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)]

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive — Cloud & Platform
Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@cloudstax.io>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@cloudstax.io>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 12:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Interest after CloudList listing — quick intro & demo?

Thanks Sergio — attaching a quick note on our needs below.

We currently expect ~100 concurrent embedding requests per minute with bursts up to 500 for short periods. For generation, it's modest (a few hundred tokens per call). Primary asks for the demo: show typical 95th/99th percentile latencies for embeddings at small batch sizes, and the Private/VPC onboarding steps and expected timelines.

Procurement (cc'd) will want SOC 2 summary and standard contracting timelines.

We can do Fri 2/20 at 11:00 AM PT (2:00 PM ET) if that's still available — that works best for the engineering and procurement folks on our side.

— Liam

Hi Liam — Aisha here on Sergio's team (SDR / scheduling). Thanks for the details — very helpful.

Quick note on availability: Sergio has a conflict at 11:00 AM PT on 2/20. He can do the following alternative on Friday 2/20: 1:00 PM PT / 4:00 PM ET. Would that still work for your engineer and procurement? If not, we can do Mon 2/22 10:00 AM PT as backup.

I've attached a Mutual Action Plan we typically run through for enterprise evaluations — it includes a short onboarding checklist and expected timelines. Also attaching a SOC 2 summary per procurement's request.

Attachments: [Redwood-Mutual-Action-Plan.xlsx (Excel, 34 KB)], [SOC2-Summary.pdf (PDF, 240 KB)]

If 1:00 PM PT works, I'll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda: 1) 15-minute demo (latency + embed cost), 2) 10-minute deployment/eng ops Q&A, 3) next steps (M.A.P + procurement).

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
